title: Final rewind to the origin
statement: Let $w$ be a Boolean word, let $p$ be an input-head position for $w$, and let $n$ be a nonnegative integer. Start the cleaner in state $2$ with its data and interval-marker tapes blank, its origin marker at cell $0$, and all heads at $n$. After exactly $n+1$ steps, it is in state $3$ with all three tapes blank and all heads at the origin.
replaced:
For every natural number $n$, running the interval cleaner for exactly $n + 1$ steps
from its rewind state with blank data and marker tapes and all heads at $n$ reaches the
silent return state with all three tapes blank and all heads at the origin, the origin
marker being erased by the final transition.
